observed_in: Religion and God System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the variety and complexity of deities within the game, including their unique characteristics, domains, and follower requirements. It varies from games with a singular deity to those featuring a pantheon of gods with diverse interactions.
exclusion_criteria: A single deity with no variation
No religious system or mechanics related to deities
inclusion_criteria: Multiple distinct gods with unique abilities and requirements
Diverse domains such as war, nature, knowledge, etc.
title: God Diversity in Roguelikes
